children: Bajaj Finance is expected to expand its assets under management quickly, driven by deeper client reach, new product offerings and India's economic growth, Jefferies analysts say in a note. Fast-paced growth, coupled with strong governance, deserves premium valuations, the U.S. bank says. The Indian company's management projects AUM to grow 23% annually over the next ten years to 40 trillion rupees, while expecting profits to grow faster, the bank says. As for the near term, the impact of El-Nino has been milder than previously feared, the analysts say. The government's credit guarantee scheme for small and medium-sized enterprises eased asset quality concerns, Jefferies says. The bank retains a buy rating and its target price of 1,280.00 rupees. Shares last closed at 1,009.00 rupees. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
